# Metric inventory: iam-authz-enrichment

<!-- Generated by `make metrics-inventory` (.github/scripts/metrics-inventory.py) from the
     Platform Observability Registry in platform-gincommon v1.6.0 and a real /metrics
     scrape of this service. Do not edit; CI fails when this file is out of date. -->

Every series carries the centrally injected const labels `domain` (`iam`), `service` (`iam-authz-enrichment`) and `environment`. The tables list each metric's own labels only. Status is the registry's: `approved`, or `proposed` (awaiting ratification by observability governance). Tier 3 metrics belong to this service and need no registry entry. See [README.md](README.md) for how the tiers are built and enforced.

## Tier 1: platform-shared metrics (emitted by the platform libraries)

This service constructs none of these; the libraries record them on the shared registry (`gincommon.MetricsRegisterer()`). A label vector appears on the scrape only once it has a sample, so for example `platform_messages_*` show up only after a consumer receives its first message, and `platform_grpc_panics_total` only after a recovered panic.

Notes specific to this service:

- `platform_grpc_*` carry all of Envoy's ext_authz traffic. A deny is a successful RPC (`grpc_code="OK"`).
- `platform_http_*` cover only `/healthz`, `/readyz` and the AsyncAPI viewer. There is no business HTTP API.
- `platform_dlq_messages_total` counts each poison message platform-events forwards to a queue's DLQ (`operation="consume"`; LLD §16 AE-36).
- `platform_queue_depth` / `platform_dlq_depth` are sampled only when `SQS_QUEUE_DEPTH_INTERVAL` is set (unset by default).
- `platform_outbox_errors_total` / `platform_outbox_dead_letter_operations_total` are registered by `events.InitMetrics` but never incremented, because this service runs no outbox.

| Metric | Emitted by | Type | Status | Labels | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `platform_build_info` | platform-gincommon | gauge | proposed | `version` | Always 1; the version label carries the build of the emitting service. |
| `platform_http_requests_total` | platform-gincommon | counter | proposed | `method`, `route`, `status_class`, `error_class` | HTTP requests completed by the server, including recovered panics (counted as 5xx). |
| `platform_http_request_duration_seconds` | platform-gincommon | histogram (request_duration) | proposed | `method`, `route`, `status_class`, `error_class` | HTTP server request latency in seconds, measured by MetricsMiddleware. |
| `platform_http_request_size_bytes` | platform-gincommon | histogram (payload_size) | proposed | `method`, `route`, `status_class`, `error_class` | HTTP request body size in bytes from Content-Length (not observed when the length is unknown, e.g. chunked uploads). |
| `platform_http_response_size_bytes` | platform-gincommon | histogram (payload_size) | proposed | `method`, `route`, `status_class`, `error_class` | HTTP response body size in bytes. |
| `platform_http_active_requests` | platform-gincommon | gauge | proposed | `route` | HTTP requests currently being handled. |
| `platform_http_panics_total` | platform-gincommon | counter | proposed | `method`, `route` | HTTP handler panics recovered by the middleware stack. |
| `platform_http_rate_limited_requests_total` | platform-gincommon | counter | proposed | `method`, `route` | HTTP requests answered with 429 Too Many Requests. |
| `platform_http_request_timeouts_total` | platform-gincommon | counter | proposed | `method`, `route` | HTTP requests whose TimeoutMiddleware deadline expired before the handler responded. |
| `platform_grpc_server_handled_total` | platform-gincommon | counter | proposed | `grpc_method`, `grpc_code`, `status_class`, `error_class` | gRPC server RPCs completed, including recovered panics (counted as Internal). |
| `platform_grpc_server_handling_seconds` | platform-gincommon | histogram (request_duration) | proposed | `grpc_method`, `status_class`, `error_class` | gRPC server RPC latency in seconds. |
| `platform_grpc_server_request_size_bytes` | platform-gincommon | histogram (payload_size) | proposed | `grpc_method`, `status_class`, `error_class` | gRPC request message size in bytes (sum over messages for streams). |
| `platform_grpc_server_response_size_bytes` | platform-gincommon | histogram (payload_size) | proposed | `grpc_method`, `status_class`, `error_class` | gRPC response message size in bytes (sum over messages for streams). |
| `platform_grpc_server_inflight_requests` | platform-gincommon | gauge | proposed | `grpc_method` | gRPC server RPCs currently being handled. |
| `platform_grpc_rate_limited_requests_total` | platform-gincommon | counter | proposed | `grpc_method` | gRPC RPCs that ended with ResourceExhausted. |
| `platform_grpc_panics_total` | platform-gincommon | counter | proposed | `grpc_method` | gRPC handler panics recovered by the interceptor stack. |
| `platform_messages_received_total` | platform-events | counter | approved | `queue` | A message delivered to a consumer by its queue (one per SQS delivery, redeliveries included), counted on receipt before it is parsed. |
| `platform_messages_processed_total` | platform-events | counter | approved | `queue`, `event_type` | A received message whose handler completed successfully, after which the message was acknowledged (deleted). Messages dead-lettered instead are counted in platform_dlq_messages_total, not here. |
| `platform_messages_failed_total` | platform-events | counter | approved | `queue`, `event_type`, `reason` | A received message that could not be processed on this delivery, by reason: malformed (not a valid envelope), decode_error (schema-registry codec failure), handler_error, handler_panic, or dead_letter_error (dead-letter handling or DLQ forwarding failed). A failed message is retried or dead-lettered; see platform_retry_total and platform_dlq_messages_total. |
| `platform_retry_total` | platform-events | counter | approved | `operation`, `event_type` | An attempt that failed and was left for automatic retry: a consumed message whose processing failed and stays on its queue for redelivery (operation=consume), or an outbox publish that failed with attempts remaining (operation=outbox_publish). |
| `platform_dlq_messages_total` | platform-events | counter | approved | `operation`, `event_type`, `reason` | A message moved to dead-letter storage: forwarded to its SQS queue's RedrivePolicy DLQ (operation=consume), or moved to outbox_dead_letters after exhausting its publish attempts (operation=outbox_publish), by reason. |
| `platform_dependency_request_seconds` | platform-events | histogram (dependency_request) | proposed | `dependency`, `operation`, `outcome` | Client-observed wall time of one call to an external dependency — SNS (publish, publish_batch), SQS (receive_message, delete_message, change_message_visibility, send_message, get_queue_attributes, get_queue_url) or the configured schema-registry codec (encode, decode) — by outcome. The _count series counts calls. receive_message is a long poll: its duration includes up to WaitTimeSeconds (default 20 s) of waiting on an empty queue, so exclude it from latency views (it stays meaningful for error rates). |
| `platform_event_propagation_seconds` | platform-events | histogram (event_propagation) | proposed | `queue`, `event_type` | Time from an event's creation (envelope `time`, set by the producer) to its FIRST receipt by a consumer (ApproximateReceiveCount ≤ 1) — end-to-end propagation delay through the outbox, SNS and SQS. Redeliveries are not observed, so retry delay does not inflate it. Negative clock skew is clamped to 0. |
| `platform_queue_depth` | platform-events | gauge | proposed | `queue` | Messages waiting on a consumer's queue to be received (SQS ApproximateNumberOfMessages — visible, not in flight or delayed), sampled by the consumer every WithQueueDepthMetrics interval. Approximate by SQS design. |
| `platform_dlq_depth` | platform-events | gauge | proposed | `queue` | Messages sitting in the dead-letter queue attached to a consumer's queue by its RedrivePolicy (SQS ApproximateNumberOfMessages of the DLQ), sampled with platform_queue_depth. queue is the SOURCE queue's name, so the gauge joins with the consumer's other queue metrics. |
| `platform_messages_in_flight` | platform-events | gauge | proposed | `queue` | Messages a consumer has received and is currently processing (decode, dead-letter routing or handler), per replica. At the consumer's concurrency limit for long periods means the replica is saturated; a value that never drops points at a hung handler (see WithHandlerTimeout). |
| `platform_message_processing_duration_seconds` | platform-events | histogram (message_processing) | proposed | `queue`, `event_type` | Wall time a consumer's handler (or dead-letter handler) spent on one delivery, whatever the outcome. |
| `platform_message_timeouts_total` | platform-events | counter | proposed | `queue`, `event_type`, `operation`<br>`operation` ∈ `decode`, `dead_letter_handler`, `handler` | A received message whose WithHandlerTimeout deadline expired, by the stage it expired in: decode (codec decode), dead_letter_handler, or handler. Each is also counted in platform_messages_failed_total under its usual reason (decode_error, dead_letter_error, handler_error) — this counter separates timeouts from other failures without changing that Canonical metric's vocabulary. |
| `platform_outbox_errors_total` | platform-events | counter | proposed | `operation`<br>`operation` ∈ `poll`, `unmarshal`, `mark_published`, `pending_count`, `leased_count`, `oldest_pending`, `blocked_count` | An outbox runner step that failed outside a publish attempt: poll (claiming a batch), unmarshal (a stored envelope that no longer parses), mark_published (an event published but not marked — it will be delivered again), pending_count / leased_count / oldest_pending / blocked_count (a gauge query). |
| `platform_outbox_dead_letter_operations_total` | platform-events | counter | proposed | `operation`<br>`operation` ∈ `reprocess`, `discard` | Outbox dead-letter records acted on by an operator call: reprocess (moved back to outbox_events for retry) or discard (permanently deleted). Counts records, not calls. |
| `platform_telemetry_label_overflow_total` | platform-events | counter | proposed | `label`<br>`label` ∈ `event_type` | A label value the library replaced because it exceeded its cardinality bound: event_type over 128 bytes → `__oversized__`, or a new distinct event_type beyond the per-process limit (default 200) → `__other__`. Counts replacements. Non-zero means a misconfigured or adversarial producer, or a limit set below the service's real number of event types. |
| `platform_library_info` | platform-events | gauge | proposed | `library`, `library_version` | Always 1. Identifies a platform library and the version a service was built with, for fleet-wide upgrade tracking. |

Registered but **not emitted** by this service: `platform_messages_published_total` (consume-only (HLD §5.4)); `platform_outbox_pending_events` (no outbox runner); `platform_outbox_leased_events` (no outbox runner); `platform_outbox_oldest_pending_age` (no outbox runner); `platform_outbox_ordering_blocked_events` (no outbox runner); `platform_outbox_publish_attempts_total` (no outbox runner); `platform_duplicate_messages_total` (dedup is Valkey `SET NX`, not platform-events' inbox (LLD AE-6)); and every platform-pgcommon `platform_db_*` metric (no database, HLD §5.4).

## Tier 2: IAM domain-shared metrics

None. The registry's `iam_*` metrics (`iam_auth_events_total`, `iam_tenant_resolution_total`, `iam_identity_sync_total`, `iam_realm_operations_total`, `iam_rls_violations_total`, `iam_auth_session_revoke_failed_total`, `iam_lifecycle_event_skipped_total`, `iam_lifecycle_event_lag_seconds`) describe identity, RLS and lifecycle concerns this stateless decision point doesn't have.

## Tier 3: service-specific metrics (`iam_authz_enrichment_*`)

Built in `internal/adapter/outbound/metrics/recorder.go`. All latency histograms use 16 exponential buckets from 0.5 ms (factor 2, up to ~16 s). Label values are every value the service records.

| Metric | Type | Labels | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `iam_authz_enrichment_authz_residency_unknown_total` | counter | - | Allow decisions where Core returned an unrecognised residency_mode; the fail-safe 'strict' default was applied (LLD §16 AE-40, CD-37). A persistent nonzero rate means Core has not yet deployed the CD-37 field or is sending an unexpected value. |
| `iam_authz_enrichment_cache_hits_total` | counter | - | ae:ctx/ae:tenant lookups that were a fresh hit. |
| `iam_authz_enrichment_cache_lookups_total` | counter | - | Total ae:ctx/ae:tenant lookups. Divide iam_authz_enrichment_cache_hits_total by this for the hit ratio. |
| `iam_authz_enrichment_decision_latency_seconds` | histogram | - | End-to-end Check() decision latency. Design budget: 15ms p99 (LLD §11.1). |
| `iam_authz_enrichment_decisions_total` | counter | `decision`<br>`decision` ∈ `allow`, `deny` | Total ext_authz decisions, by decision (allow/deny). Exactly one per Check call, including requests with no verified subject. |
| `iam_authz_enrichment_deny_reason_total` | counter | `reason`<br>`reason` ∈ `deny_malformed_identity`, `deny_mfa_stale`, `deny_role_insufficient`, `deny_service_unavailable`, `deny_tenant_read_only`, `deny_tender_acl_insufficient`, `deny_unresolvable_subject` | Total deny decisions, by DenyReason, lowercased for the registry's snake_case reason vocabulary (DENY_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE is deny_service_unavailable). |
| `iam_authz_enrichment_eviction_errors_total` | counter | `event`<br>`event` ∈ `membership_revoked`, `user_deleted` | Best-effort EvictTenderACLForUser failures, by event. A nonzero rate means ae:tender_acl entries for revoked/deleted users may persist until their 15s TTL. |
| `iam_authz_enrichment_i12_call_latency_seconds` | histogram | - | iam-tender-acl TAC-4 (formerly Org & Membership's I-12) tender-ACL call latency; name kept for continuity (LLD §16 AE-19). |
| `iam_authz_enrichment_i14_call_latency_seconds` | histogram | - | Org & Membership MFA-freshness (I-14) call latency. |
| `iam_authz_enrichment_i8_call_latency_seconds` | histogram | - | Org & Membership membership-rebuild (I-8) call latency. |
| `iam_authz_enrichment_negative_cache_hits_total` | counter | - | ae:neg lookups that hit. |
| `iam_authz_enrichment_negative_cache_lookups_total` | counter | - | Total ae:neg lookups. |
| `iam_authz_enrichment_singleflight_coalesced_total` | counter | - | Membership-rebuild calls coalesced by singleflight instead of issued. |
| `iam_authz_enrichment_stale_if_error_served_total` | counter | - | Requests served from a stale ae:ctx entry under §7's stale-if-error rule. A nonzero rate means a live dependency outage is in progress — page on this. |
| `iam_authz_enrichment_tac4_errors_total` | counter | - | GetTenderACL (TAC-4) errors — iam-tender-acl dependency failures that made the tender-ACL overlay fail closed. Distinct from legitimate DENY_TENDER_ACL_INSUFFICIENT policy denials. |

The cache hit ratios are exposed as hits/lookups counter pairs, never a server-computed ratio gauge, so they aggregate correctly across replicas and time windows.
